items.title: 'Take or pay': AI companies are taking a risky page from the energy sector's playbook

items.title: Is the "seven-day plan" back on the table? The US and Iran are said to plan talks with mediators, as Iran's supreme leader says the era of Western interference is over
items.summary: New movement in US-Iran diplomatic contacts over the Strait of Hormuz and the nuclear issue: reports cited by Xinhua and CCTV indicate that mediators such as Qatar are pushing for indirect talks between the US and Iran in the coming days, and Iran's earlier "seven-day plan" may be the focus of those contacts.
